scope: Desktop Lua fake-environment v1/v2 diagnostic cost/resource comparison only. Synthetic callback timings and gaps are not native performance measurements.

candidate.sourceDriftGuard: PASS: both capture sources and fixture unchanged across50 runs

host.gameClient: None: isolated child Lua processes; no game input or preference changes.

protocol.order: v1/v2 in pairs1,3,5;v2/v1 in pairs2,4. Cases off,quiet,slow,fast,gaps in each pair.
protocol.slowInput: Two synthetic slow spans per frame:25msEvents and12msScheduler. Native callback work/core seam timing is not executed.
protocol.fastInput: Twenty synthetic0.03msEvents spans per frame across10 fixed keys;400,000 observed callbacks and no >=10ms slow records.
protocol.collection: Host Lua collection before measured startup/drive and after stop, outside measured drive. Capture itself only sees mocked count reads and never forces native collection.
protocol.timer: Raw per-region Luaos.clock values retained without assuming Windows CRT clock means processCPU. Whole child wall measured with Pythonperf_counter and child user/kernelCPU measured separately with WindowsGetProcessTimes. Whole child includes parse/warmup.
protocol.startup: Warmed start after a2000-frame watch warmup; the sole owned frame is reused. Cold first-start frame creation not timed.
protocol.heap: Process-global KB net deltas; not cumulative allocated bytes, addon allocation attribution or leak proof.
protocol.diagnosticClock: debugprofilestop and report syntheticDiagnosticMs are synthetic fixture clocks, not measured diagnostic overhead.
protocol.interpretation: v2 collects additional per-frame fan-out metadata and1Hz heap context. Positive enabled deltas are the cost of those new diagnostics; disabled behavior and bounded resource ownership are the regression targets.

retainedV1Evidence: Previous25-run spike-watch-comparison-20261106/comparison.json retained unchanged at its original scope.

functionalResourceResult: PASS: dormant paths retain zero frame/timer/observer/metric work; enabled cases one reused frame, zero timers/enumerations, bounded records/labels and complete observer/key/function-cache cleanup. v2 quiet/slow/fast200s cases make198coarse samples in these inputs, with no saved heap time series.
nativeAcceptance: PENDING: no random spike cause, taint, secure behavior, rendering, FPS improvement or memory leak is established by these fake-environment runs.
